Definition
[Semigroup, contraction semigroup] 1. ch7:7.4.1-def-1\group Semigroup Theory (i) A family $\{ S(t)\} _{t \geq 0}$ of bounded linear operators mapping $X$ into $X$ is called a semigroup if conditions (4)--(6) are satisfied.

(ii) We say $\{ S(t)\} _{t \geq 0}$ is a contraction semigroup if in addition \[ \| S(t)\| \leq 1 \quad (t \geq 0), \tag {7} \] $\| \cdot \| $ here denoting the operator norm. Thus \[ \| S(t)u\| \leq \| u\| \quad (t \geq 0, u \in X). \]
